policy.mts: one retained generation; no reset, unload, unbind, rearm or administrative changes
policy.results: Local private evidence; review and redact before sharing. Inventory is observation, not a functional PASS.

tests.title: Hardware inventory
tests.description: Read CPU, RAM, kernel, PCI, USB, input, thermal and block-device metadata. Never open a disk for data.

tests.title: Bounded CPU computation
tests.description: One worker repeats a known SHA-256 computation for 1–10 seconds. This does not qualify all cores, clocks or cooling.

tests.title: Owned memory pattern
tests.description: Check patterns in 1–128 MiB owned by one worker, leaving a fixed system reserve. No physical-memory or VRAM access.

tests.title: Ethernet status
tests.description: Read interface/carrier/counters, native driver report and route metadata. Do not open, arm or change the interface.

tests.title: Connect Ethernet once
tests.description: Explicitly run the installed first-publication/DHCP helper (120-second limit), then observe carrier, addressing and routes. The helper owns the one-generation gate; this is not autoload qualification.

tests.title: Interface-bound HTTPS
tests.description: Explicit user-supplied HTTPS URL, verified TLS, no proxy or redirects, bound to an already connected interface. Record address, route and transfer evidence.

tests.title: Offscreen EGL information
tests.description: Explicitly run eglinfo -B -p surfaceless with no window-display environment. May initialize the GPU; no pixel oracle or functional PASS.

tests.title: Headless Vulkan information
tests.description: Explicitly run vulkaninfo --summary without a window display. Enumerated APIs/devices are not rendered-frame validation.

tests.title: Audio devices
tests.description: Read ALSA card and PCM metadata; no sound is played.

tests.title: 44.1 kHz fixture playback
tests.description: Play an explicitly selected, hashed PCM WAV of at most 20 seconds at 44.1 kHz. Audible output, pitch and duration require operator confirmation.

tests.title: Storage inventory only
tests.description: Read sysfs model, size, transport path and mount metadata. No raw disk reads, writes, mounts, filesystem repair, format or image growth.

tests.title: UVD AVC decoding
tests.description: Unsupported in this ordinary kernel image. The experimental UVD derivative requires its own matched stack and lifecycle plan.

tests.title: Native 48 kHz audio
tests.description: Deferred. The supported output profile is 44.1 kHz; resampled 48 kHz content is distinct from native 48 kHz.

tests.title: Wi-Fi exploration
tests.description: Working on recorded firmware-equipped setups. New exploration is deferred pending a specific reproducible bug.

tests.title: Bluetooth exploration
tests.description: Working on recorded firmware-equipped setups. No automatic pairing, firmware loading or radio-state changes.

tests.title: Power-off qualification
tests.description: Blocked in this runner. Requires an external UART/session receipt and the separate operator power-test stage; never executes a power command.

tests.title: Reboot qualification
tests.description: Blocked pending separate reboot-path review and an externally observed experiment. Never executes a reboot command.

tests.title: Suspend / hibernate
tests.description: Excluded because retained-DMA lifecycle support is not established.
